name: – Stéphanie Yon-Courtin – After § 3 – Am 1
title: REPORT on competition policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 3a. Stresses that competition policy should not hinder the implementation of an active industrial strategy; calls for the Member States and the EU to pursue an active industrial strategy underpinned by strong public investment, in order to fight social and regional inequality, decarbonise industry and bolster autonomy in key economic sectors, while contributing globally to even and sustainable economic development; underlines that, as Europe faces increasingly frequent and severe heatwaves and climate disasters, competition rules must not prevent Member States from making the public investments and granting the support necessary to protect people, adapt infrastructure, strengthen public services and accelerate the ecological transformation of industry;
